decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed conversion of the existing family dwellinghouse into a four (4) bedroomed flat and a two (2) bedroom maisonette flat is considered to be unsuitable for the following reasons;

(i)	The maisonette flat is considered to be unsuitable accommodation as a result of the internal organisation, size of rooms, the availability of suitable private amenity space and its relationship to the existing dwellinghouse.  

(ii)	The proposal fails to provide adequate independent parking arrangements for both the dwellinghouse and the maisonette flat.  

And would, as a result, have an adverse impact on the amenity of adjoining owners and the nature of the surrounding area and is contrary to Policies ENV 1.1, H1.5. and T2.5 of Council's Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed roof extension, because its size, design and appearance would dominate the roof, and be at odds with the style and character of the building, as well as being out of character with conservation area.  The proposal is considered to adversely affect the amenity of adjoining neighbours and be contrary to policies ENV.1.1 ENV.1.2 and H.3.4 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan.
description: Change of use to two self contained flats, erection of single storey and two storey side extension and roof extension to existing dwellinghouse
